title: Ever seen a full-circle rainbow?🌈 This isn’t a lens trick — it’s a gl...
description: Ever seen a full-circle rainbow?🌈 This isn’t a lens trick — it’s a glory. One of the rarest and coolest optical phenomena you’ll ever spot from above the clouds. Perfect alignment. Sun behind me. Clouds below. For a few seconds, nature decided to show off — a complete rainbow wrapped in a circle around my shadow ✈️ Moments like this are why I never get tired of looking out the window. Have you ever seen a glory before? 👀 👇👇👇 #aviation #pilotview #glory #fullcirclerainbow #opticalphenomenon
